_comment: Source catalogue for Kings Island. Official listings are JS-rendered; heights sidecar is the ground truth until a cache is built. External adapters sync via npm run venues:sync-sources -- kings-island.

sources.used_for: Park geometry, coasters, paths, buildings, and named districts.
Height requirements and attraction names for the 2026 season.

Ride labels, food, restrooms, walking paths and queue entrances when georeferenced (illustrated handout — TPS). Acquire the map image via npm run venues:research -- kings-island --ai (LLM park-map search).

adapters.ropedrop: RopeDrop open data covers Disney/Universal parks only — not applicable to Cedar Fair venues.

research.note: LLM may propose aliases and height candidates from official HTML; code decides. LLM park-map search is required to locate guest-map image/PDF assets for tracing. Never invents coordinates.
